title: Trust Mark Status Response
description: JSON Schema for validating the Trust Mark Status Response documents as defined in OpenID Connect Federation 1.0 - February 17, 2026.

status.description: REQUIRED. Case-sensitive string indicating the current status of the Trust Mark. Values defined by this specification are 'active', 'expired', 'revoked', and 'invalid'. Additional values MAY be defined and used.

anyOf.description: Extension status value not defined by this specification.
